svg.title: STRATOS system architecture (proposed)
svg.desc: Functional block diagram: sensing, control, onboard storage, telemetry, ground station, reconciliation and power.
svg.text: Proposed design, Rev A. One baseline: the same parts appear in the BOM, schematic, pin map, power budget and CAD model.
Charging: normally in an external charger; supervised USB-C bench charging only with the shell removed.
USB on the ESP32 board is used only with SW1 OFF (pole B disconnects the regulator from the rail).
Where errors can occur (E) and where they are detected (D)
sensor read fails or value implausible
controller sets *_INVALID flag, writes sentinel / empty field
microSD write or flush fails; card removed
SD_WRITE_ERR flag; per-line CRC exposes damaged lines
radio does not report TX complete
tx = 'F' in onboard log; RADIO_ERR flag in next packet
frame lost or corrupted on the link
ground CRC-16 rejects frame; pkt_seq gap logged
new session ID; time restart visible; truncated line fails CRC
VBAT monitor → VBAT_LOW flag → safe shutdown closes the log
reconciliation classifies every discrepancy or reports it as unresolved
